description.value: Tenen Restaurant is a Serbian and Eastern European diner in Burnaby, founded in 2015 by two childhood friends from Knin — a Roman-era town whose ancient name, Tenen, the restaurant carries. The menu features hearty Balkan staples like chevapi, karadjordjeva schnitzel, cabbage rolls, and traditional meze, served in a kitschy, homey atmosphere that reviewers describe as feeling like coming home. A loyalty program and catering service round out the offering.
